card.name: CFR and legal citation abbreviations
card.fires_on: The abbreviation CFR (or its last letter) right after a title number in regulation citations, such as 21 CFR or 42 CFR. It also fires on U.S.C., US and F.3d in legal citations.

modes.label: CFR after title number
modes.description: The letters CFR directly after a number such as 21, 42, 10 or 45 in a regulation citation.

modes.label: Other legal citation parts
modes.description: Pieces of statute or case citations such as U.S.C., US or F.3d, and subsection markers.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a legal reference where a regulation or court citation abbreviation like CFR is being written.
